name: gale

height.instrument: HiRISE stereo (USGS MSL Gale merged DEM 1 m)

sources.terrain_class: Estimate: HiRISE albedo + DTM roughness, until terrain_cls.onnx and THEMIS
sources.rocks_fine: HiRISE DTM roughness estimate retained + human-reviewed NASA/JPL ROSCO positive rocks from ESP_019698_1750 (2010-10-09), registered to the USGS Gale mosaic; 8 m clearance padding. Positive additions only, not complete hazard coverage.
sources.cost_to_go: Pandolf walking model (gravity factor and sand from #83) over walk-scale crossings (passable.u8)

optical.instrument: HiRISE colour (USGS MSL Gale LRGB 25 cm)

sources.terrain: Hillshade of the 1 m HiRISE terrain, averaged to 8 m
sources.fine_steep: % of the cell steeper than the slope limit at 2 m scale (1 m HiRISE terrain)
sources.dropoff: Largest height change between neighbouring 1 m points, m (1 m HiRISE terrain)
sources.crevice: Deepest trough or fracture narrower than ~5 m, m (1 m HiRISE terrain)
sources.landform: 0 flat, 1 slope, 2 ridge, 3 hollow (height vs 21 m neighbourhood, 1 m HiRISE terrain)
sources.open_dirs: Neighbours you can step to (0-8), checked along the 1 m profile; step limit 0.3 m (NASA ICES-2025-294)
sources.reach: 1 = reachable from base through passable crossings
sources.chokepoint: How many reachable cells' shortest way from base passes here, log scale 0-1 (1 = all)
sources.unsure: Share of crossings close to a limit: where the helicopter should look (0-1)
sources.passable: Bit k: can step to neighbour k (order as app/src/plan.js NB); see data/pipeline/terrain_1m.py

thermal_inertia.instrument: THEMIS night IR (Mars Trek 100 m mosaic; relative 0-255, higher = rockier)

science.instrument: CRISM hydration browse, 5 obs (FRT000058A3, FRT0000B6F1, HRL0000BABA, FRT0001BBA1, FRT0001CA91); tertiles 1-3

dose_rate.instrument: RAD mean 0.210 mGy/day (Hassler 2014) x HiRISE sky-view factor (estimate)

site.name: Gale crater, lower Mount Sharp boxwork

energy_budget_note: knob: sized so the five-stop Curiosity tour uses ~80% of usable energy

scout.note: extra flights after the route corridor; made by data/pipeline/scout_plan.py
